program:
module
public import Lib.General.Analysis.OstrowskiTaussky
public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.NumberField.Discriminant.Basic
@[expose] public section
open NumberField Real Matrix
open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PeriodRepairControls

theorem period (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (D : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hprod : p = rootDiscr K ^ n)
    (hx : (‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ n = p / √(D : ℝ) ^ n) :
    ‖z‖ ^ 2 = rootDiscr K / √(D : ℝ) := by
  erw [← pow_left_inj₀ (n := n), div_pow, ← hprod]
  exact hx
  all_goals first | positivity | rw [rootDiscr_def]; positivity

theorem box {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {ρ L : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ≤ L)
    (G : Type) (M : G → Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ ({x | ‖M x‖ ≤ ρ} : Set G) → ∀ i j, ‖M x i j‖ ≤ L ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
  intro x hx i j
  change ‖M x‖ ≤ ρ at hx
  rw [pow_one]
  exact (norm_apply_le_l2_opNorm (A := M x) i j).trans (hx.trans hρ)

#print axioms period
#print axioms box
end PeriodRepairControls
result:
'PeriodRepairControls.period' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'PeriodRepairControls.box' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
scope: The original NumberField.rootDiscr, Mathlib power lemmas, and project norm_apply_le_l2_opNorm are imported. The number field, weighted product identity, operator matrix, and bounds are variables. This verifies the two typed steps, independently of the remaining production source.
